items.body:
# RFC: Version Pinning for add-skill

Add support for installing specific versions of skills via git tags, commits, or branches.

## Problem

- No way to pin a skill to a specific version
- Setups are non-reproducible across machines/team members
- If a skill author pushes a breaking change, your setup breaks silently
- No way to audit what version is installed or roll back

## Proposal

### Syntax

```bash
npx add-skill owner/repo@v1.0.0      # tag
npx add-skill owner/repo@abc1234     # commit sha
npx add-skill owner/repo@main        # explicit branch
npx add-skill owner/repo             # la
items.title: [RFC] Versioning

Telemetry is currently sent to a hardcoded endpoint (`https://add-skill.vercel.sh/t`). We can disable telemetry (`DISABLE_TELEMETRY` / `DO_NOT_TRACK`), but in enterprise environments we often host **internal skills** and still want install counts/usage metrics **stored internally**, not sent to a third-party endpoint.

Support a **custom telemetry endpoint** without forking.

#### Proposed config (priority order)
1) Env var override: `SKILLS_TELEMETRY_URL=https://telemetry.myco.example/t`
2) **Preferred**: Global npm config / `.npmrc` (admin-set once; works well with `npx`): e.g.
